On an SBC-consistent basis peers trade at a median of 28.3x NTM. GLW deserves about 27x after GLW-specific post-horizon risks, mainly a fibre price reset as Prysmian and Fujikura capacity lands. The DCF legs, now verified against a 5.24% 10-year yield, pull value toward $111. The AI-capex digestion risk is correctly left in peer multiples and the bear tail. key_drivers: Valuation: GLW trades at 38.2x consensus NTM EPS ($4.10). Prysmian (>$1.2B, more than doubling U.S. output, new preform plant) and Fujikura (¥300bn, up to 3x) are adding capacity whose online dates are not disclosed. A 50% chance of a partial price reset costs about $5/share in the horizon multiple.

Contract visibility and funding: a $1.0B deposit LTA runs through Dec 31, 2029; contract liabilities are $2.7B; a $2B ATM (1.46% dilution) is the only material dilution, and the $296M deposit warrant is the same 15M @ $180 warrant (counted once).
Extreme volatility (realized 68-77%) keeps the 12-month distribution very wide whatever the centre.
